roadmap.goal: Read surfaces (yesterday anchor, /entries and /trend windows) use the device-local day, not server UTC (A5 rule extended to reads). RCA: nw-bugfix 2026-07-24.

steps.name: Skew-frame regression ATs RED, then client-day fix GREEN
steps.description: Author skew-frame regression scenarios (device day != UTC day) asserting RENDERED surfaces, confirm they fail against current code, then implement client-authoritative day frame: recent-days map + inline-script yesterday anchor on GET /, today=<device day> param on /entries and /trend fetches with C6-safe server validation.
criteria: Regression scenarios fail against pre-fix code for the business reason (evening skew shows next-day frame), with a non-tautological oracle: expected values derived from device_day, never from the server clock
At 02:00 UTC with the phone still on the previous day, the entry screen's yesterday anchor names the entry from device_day - 1 (this morning's entry is never labeled yesterday)
At the same skew moment, the 1W raw window spans [device_day - 6, device_day] and the 1W trend window likewise — the oldest day does not vanish in the evening
A hostile or malformed today= value on /entries or /trend never 500s (400 or bounded UTC fallback, C6 preserved); the value is bounded by the same MAX_DEVICE_SKEW_DAYS rule as saves
Entry screen script budget AT stays green: exactly one inline script block, zero external scripts (G-5); glance, save, rejection flows byte-for-byte unchanged
Full suite green; ports.py ClockPort contract wording strengthened; ADR-007 prose amended to 'zero new script blocks / external scripts' (user-approved 2026-07-24)
steps.implementation_notes: RCA chain: routes.py:276 yesterday=now_utc-1; routes.py:332,348 windows on now_utc.date(). Core already parameterized (types.py windowing takes today) — fix is shell-only. GET /: replace server-picked yesterday_kg with a small recent-days map (last ~4 entries {iso_day: kg}) embedded as Jinja value INSIDE the existing inline script; script computes deviceLocalDay() and renders #yesterday-reference from map[device_day-1]; no new script blocks, no external requests. graph.html: append today=deviceLocalDay() to /entries and /trend fetches. Server: parse+validate today param (total parser precedent: core/types.py parse_time_scale — hostile input 400), bound by MAX_DEVICE_SKEW_DAYS vs server UTC, fall back to UTC when absent (curl/API compat). Test harness: fake_clock/composition already have device_day override for POST (composition.py:97,171-172) — extend to render/fetch paths; break the resolve_day() oracle tautology (composition.py:154-158): expected yesterday derives from device_day. Keep telemetry/event timestamps UTC (by design). Journey failure-mode addition rides the finalize commit, orchestrator-owned.
